changes: Shared 60-second single-launch readiness outside serialized preflight and before Pause; explicit trusted download anchors warm the app without intercepting navigation.
Persistent YouTube card overlays survive preview removal and nested renderer updates.
Clicked LinkedIn source attributes/activity identity replace ambiguous feed-wide selection; Loom canonical pages use native extraction.
Explicit video-only metadata no longer requires a nonexistent audio stream; the choice persists in encrypted resume metadata.
limits: The cold-start fixture uses twelve seconds of simulated native startup; it is not a measured PC reboot.
Generic opaque/POST/blob downloads still require the browser response; no claim of pre-response capture for every navigation.
LinkedIn is tested with controlled multi-player feed sources and post identity; the user signed-in feed was not accessed.
The supplied Loom clip advertises video-only formats and the final file has no audio track.
Normal Chrome UI automation stopped on active-URL verification. Reloading the existing extension and refreshing pages remains manual.
Initial hidden-player locator, video-only selector, overlong private fixture path and updater compatibility failures are excluded from acceptance.
